note: Levels for common words the OpenJLPT vocabulary lists lack. No official JLPT vocabulary list exists, so each level follows a published word-level listing when one exists; otherwise it is at least the highest OpenJLPT level of the word's kanji, taking the harder rating when sources disagree. Each entry records its evidence and reviewer.
